# Junky Gurus LLC

> Professional junk removal services in Mount Vernon, WA and the Puget Sound Region.

Junky Gurus is a locally owned junk removal company serving Skagit, Whatcom, Snohomish, and King Counties in Washington State. We provide fast, reliable junk removal with transparent pricing and responsible disposal practices.

## Services

- [Residential Junk Removal](/services#residential): Furniture, mattresses, electronics, household items
- [Appliance Removal](/services#appliances): Refrigerators, washers, dryers, stoves, water heaters
- [Yard Waste & Debris](/services#yard-waste): Branches, leaves, brush, storm debris
- [Garage & Estate Cleanouts](/services#cleanouts): Full property cleanouts, hoarding situations
- [Construction Debris](/services#construction): Drywall, lumber, flooring, renovation waste
- [Commercial Cleanouts](/services#commercial): Office furniture, equipment, retail fixtures
- [Light Demolition](/services#light-demolition): Deck, shed, fence removal
- [Hazardous Materials Pickup](/services#hazmat-pickup): Paint, batteries, chemicals, e-waste

## Service Area

We serve the following counties in Washington State:
- Skagit County (Mount Vernon, Burlington, Anacortes, Sedro-Woolley)
- Whatcom County (Bellingham, Lynden, Ferndale, Blaine)
- Snohomish County (Everett, Marysville, Arlington, Lake Stevens)
- King County (North Seattle, Shoreline, Kenmore, Bothell)

## Hours of Operation

Monday - Saturday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM
Sunday: Closed

## Pricing Model

Volume-based pricing from $125 minimum load to $750 full truck load. Single item pricing available. Free on-site estimates. No hidden fees.

## Additional Information

- Same-day service available
- Bilingual service (English & Spanish)
- Eco-friendly disposal with donation and recycling
- Licensed and insured
- AI-powered photo estimates available
